findings.title: `queued` is fixed at module import time
findings.body: `timezone.now()` is evaluated once when this module is imported, so every `AssignmentSource` created without an explicit `queued` value gets the same timestamp rather than its own creation time. Since `to_dict()` serializes this field, the recorded queue time is inaccurate for all later assignments. Use a `default_factory` so the timestamp is generated per instance.
